chain.look: tools/homm3_unit_look/look.py <unit> --force (run by fleet_rebuild.py), frozen copies under <out>/<unit>/inputs
chain.idleRetime: applied at freeze: tools/homm3_idle_cadence/retime_idle.py on the frozen look-delivered GLB
